ModMetaData.name: Wil's Role Modules : Intelligence
ModMetaData.author: Spaceman_Wil
ModMetaData.description: Assistant, Researcher and the specialties Inventor, Analyst, Geneticist, Dark Scholar (Dark Study) and Author. Experience comes from real research, scanning, Anomaly study, xenogerm making and writing books; specialty bonuses apply only to a qualified pawn assigned to that exact specialty. Dark Study needs Anomaly, Geneticist needs Biotech and Author needs books to write: without them those specialties simply have no work. Early draft: offline builds and tests do not constitute RimWorld gameplay validation.
